name: Synthetic ridge-floor training set (scenario B geometry)
usageRestrictions: Synthetic data from a simplified, uncalibrated channel model. Suitable for testing the pipeline and for training/evaluating baselines on the same simulator; not evidence of real-world performance.
captureMethodology: Generated by models/baselines/ridge_floor/train.py with the Python reference simulator (echospace_sim) and pipeline (echospace_inference.ReferenceEngine). Fixed scenario-B geometry; per scene: random waypoint walks (0.5-1.4 m/s) with stops, sits and turns for 0, 1 or 2 subjects, random start delays giving empty-room segments. Regenerated deterministically from the seeds; the arrays are not committed.
sampleFormat: per frame (10 Hz): float32 features [deltaRssDb x28, motionEnergy x28]; uint8 floor target 12x10 cells (0.5 m, x fastest); float32 rti-bayes floor projection 12x10

sceneMetadata.targetDefinition: cell = 1 if its centre is within subject radius + 0.25 m of a present subject
